headline: Space Cadet Pinball
title: Space Cadet Pinball Facts | The Windows Game That Vanished | Classic Games
video_script: Space Cadet Pinball was the Windows game many of us played in school computer labs. It is the Space Cadet table from Full Tilt Pinball, made by Cinematronics, and it came with Microsoft Plus ninety five, then several Windows versions. Windows XP was the last one to include it. Microsoft engineer Raymond Chen explained that a collision detection bug appeared while porting Windows to sixty four bit, so the game was dropped. Did you ever get the high score? Comment below!
